text_block_list.text:
One day, I stopped by a cafe to take a 
break, and while sitting at a table—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, boy over there! If you went for a 
drive, which sounds nicer: the coast, or 
an unfamiliar city?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, girl over there! If you went for a 
drive, which sounds nicer: the coast, or 
an unfamiliar city?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We're all going for a drive together now, 
but we just can't decide which one to 
choose!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
See, you could play some recommended folk 
tunes and take a sentimental drive along 
the coast, or...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Going off to an unfamiliar town and 
feeling that thrilling excitement is 
totally fab, don'tcha think~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Italian for lunch, then catching disco 
fever all night! I'm sure that'll get 
everyone totally refreshed~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I said I was asking for your 
opinions! My bad, my bad~!

Though overwhelmed by the intense 
nostalgic aroma wafting forth, I voiced my 
thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Right, nothing beats the beach after all~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The roads are wide over there, so tearing 
down them in my beloved car feels 
absolutely amazing ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the sea was definitely the right 
choice! Thanks, you really helped me out♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A drive's gotta have some excitement, 
after all. Plus, we might even discover a 
whole new route♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll give it a shot! Thanks for 
giving me that little push♪

She drained the nata de coco sitting on 
the table, tossed out a breezy "Byeee!" 
and walked away.
